Room.title: Online Battle Room
Room.description: Shared 1v1 online room lobby, match lifecycle state, synchronized clock anchor, and rematch votes.

matchType.description: Match rule format chosen by the host.

roundNumber.description: Monotonically increasing match round counter for rematches.

hostId.description: Immutable session or user ID of the room creator.

hostName.description: Public display nickname for the host player.

hostLevel.description: Persistent profile progression level (1 to 300) of the host player.

guestId.description: Session or user ID of Player 2 (empty string while waiting).

guestName.description: Public display nickname for Player 2 (empty string while waiting).

guestLevel.description: Persistent profile progression level (0 while waiting, 1 to 300 once joined) of Player 2.

matchStartAtMs.description: Synchronized epoch timestamp (ms) when active gameplay begins.

suddenDeath.description: True when a tied 2-minute match enters Sudden Death.

winnerRole.description: Winning player role when match finishes.

finishReason.description: Short human-readable reason the match concluded.

hostRematch.description: True when the host has requested a rematch.

guestRematch.description: True when the guest has requested a rematch.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last room state change.

PlayerSyncState.title: Online Player Live Board State
PlayerSyncState.description: Real-time board grid, active piece, score, KO counters, garbage attack totals, and heartbeat for one player in a room.

playerId.description: Immutable session or user ID matching hostId or guestId on parent room.

nickname.description: Public display nickname for this player.

playerLevel.description: Persistent profile progression level (1 to 300) for rank badge and trail sync.

roundNumber.description: Active round number this board snapshot belongs to.

grid.description: Compact 200-char encoding of the 20x10 visible playfield grid.

hold.description: Held piece type or empty string.

holdUsed.description: Whether hold has already been used for the current drop.

next3.description: Next 3 tetromino types encoded as a 0-3 char string.

kosTaken.description: Authoritative count of KOs suffered by this player in the current round.

linesCleared.description: Total lines cleared in the current round.

maxCombo.description: Highest combo streak achieved in the current round.

garbageSent.description: Monotonic cumulative garbage attack lines sent in the current round.

piecesPlaced.description: Total pieces locked in the current round.

incomingReady.description: Incoming garbage lines ready to rise on next lock.

nextGapCol.description: Column index of the next incoming Bomb Block (-1 if none).

lastAttackLabel.description: Human-readable description of the most recent attack.

bombBlastsSeq.description: Monotonic counter incremented each time this player detonates bomb blocks.

lastBombCount.description: Number of bomb blocks cleared in the most recent detonation.

connected.description: Live connection flag set false on clean exit.

heartbeatMs.description: Client epoch timestamp (ms) refreshed periodically for disconnect detection.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of this live state update.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Online 1v1 room metadata, match timer anchor, status transitions, and shared rematch state.

/rooms/{roomCode}/players/{role}.description: Per-player live board state, stats, garbage attack counters, and connection heartbeat for host and guest.
